title: Candidate decoding assignment law
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet $\text{Fin}(q)$, let each vertex $v$ have a finite candidate set $C_v\subseteq \text{Fin}(q)$, and choose a default label $a_0\in\text{Fin}(q)$. The candidate decoding assignment law on labelings of all vertices is the independent product of the candidate decoding label laws at the individual vertices.
